basis: Infection-associated glomerular inflammation; associated endocarditis is a separate disease, so cardiovascular is excluded.
Immune-mediated inflammatory peripheral neuropathy; muscle wasting is secondary to denervation. Congenital skeletal findings do not characterize most patients across both forms.
Immune-mediated glomerular injury with mesangial proliferation; associated systemic diseases are separate diagnoses.
Marrow failure; pancreatic insufficiency 2/4, metaphyseal dysplasia 2/4 and developmental delay 3/8 support involvement. Retinal dystrophy 2/8 is below threshold.
Benign tumour arising in the lacrimal gland.
Parasitic infection with disseminated skin lesions; definition explicitly excludes visceral involvement.
Allergen-mediated inflammation of the middle ear.
Focal neurologic movement disorder; abnormal muscle contraction and soreness do not establish direct skeletal muscle disease.
Inherited dental enamel hypoplasia; teeth belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Organic acid metabolism disorder; neurodevelopmental impairment affects most patients, roughly 60-80%. Cardiomyopathy frequency varies and is not consistently above 30%.
Histiocytic proliferation defined by nodular skin infiltration and destructive arthritis, both present in 80-99%.
Inherited arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy predominantly affecting the right ventricle.
Benign tumour of breast parenchyma; breast has no axis.
Established osteoporosis directly affects bone; corticosteroid exposure is its cause, not an additional organ manifestation.
Premature cranial suture fusion defines the disorder. Strabismus 11/72 and developmental or brain abnormalities are below 30%.
Defined by magnesium and lipid abnormalities together with hypertension; no additional organ damage is established by the supplied evidence.
Ocular refractive disorder caused by irregular optical curvature.
Malignancy arising in the thoracic oesophagus; thoracic location does not imply pulmonary involvement.
Lymphoid blood-cell malignancy arising in the lung; lymphoma also requires the infectious_immune mechanism axis.
Peripheral nerve and nerve-root injury defines this umbrella; immune-mediated mechanisms apply to specific subtypes rather than every polyradiculoneuropathy.
Marrow dysfunction, exocrine pancreatic insufficiency and immunodeficiency define SDS; skeletal dysplasia occurs in >50%. Learning deficits omitted under the four-axis cap.
Inherited oxysterol metabolism disorder; neurologic and hepatic disease occur in different subtypes, with no shared organ frequency established for this umbrella.
Immunodeficiency with sweat-gland, hair and dental defects; conical teeth occur in 80-99% and colitis in 30-79%. Recurrent otitis is a separate infection.
Congenital myopathy defined by generalized skeletal muscle hypercontractility and stiffness.
Congenital absence or severe underdevelopment of the retina; retinal disease belongs to the ocular axis.
